Thank you for your interest in CSU Dominguez Hills! This articulation agreement displays lower-division course requirements specific to this major. Students are advised to meet with an academic counselor when planning to transfer to CSU Dominguez Hills and refer to the University Catalog to learn more about this major and its features. Detailed admissions requirements for transfer students are available on the CSUDH campus website. Completion of Statutory Requirements (United States History, Constitution and American Ideals) is a baccalaureate degree requirement for the California State University system and may be met prior to transfer with eligible California Community College (CCC) courses designated as US-1, US-2, and US-3. Completion of Statutory Requirements prior to transfer is most advantageous and strongly encouraged as a number of CCC courses that meet this requirement might also double-count for General Education.

Theatre Electives: In addition to lower division dance classes, transfer students may complete a lower division theatre course articulated with CSUDH's THE 264 Acting I if available, or complete one of the upper division courses listed below after transfer.


  • THE 342 Fundamentals of Theatre Design
  • THE 346 Theatre Workshop


Advisory: Students should take advantage of all available choreography and performance opportunities and view as many dance performances as possible.
